canonical_rows.order: Prepared DEV dialogue order, then each targets-dev record rows in source order; contiguous global row_index
canonical_rows.source_join: Join prepared actor query_ids to row query_index; candidate IDs must equal original catalog order and label_id must equal candidate_ids[label_index]. Keep actor annotations separate.

denominator_source.scope: Only previously recorded support counts read; aggregate strata agree with new preparation plan.

metrics.assigned_retention_error: Incorrect assigned-retention endpoints divided by all assigned-retention endpoints.
metrics.boolean_slot: Set of stripped casefold ordinary candidate values exactly equals {true,false}; reserved values excluded.
metrics.brier: Mean over endpoints of sum over candidates (exp(float64(log_probs))-onehot)^2.
metrics.macro_accuracy: Equal mean of unmentioned_retention, assigned_retention and pooled changed count ratios; then equal three-seed mean.
metrics.nll: Mean negative target log_probs promoted directly to float64, no exp/log roundtrip.
metrics.types: All/seen/unseen, all five bins, per service and candidate types with zero support explicit and undefined rates null.

predictions.choice: First supported argmax in supplied canonical candidate order
predictions.failure: Supported -inf/NaN/+inf or invalid mass is technical failure. Preserve raw offending artifacts and failure receipt, report no complete gate and drop no endpoints.

npz_fields.log_probs: float32[N,12], finite at every supported candidate, -inf only padding

predictions.repair: None; no temperature, clipping, floor, second softmax or renormalization

remaining_authoring: Pure metrics helper and tests next; future runner/reporter must authenticate full source, preparation and execution lineage before metrics. No scientific fit authorized by this note.

adapt: report_dialogue_copy_v2 invariant aggregation/validation per single-dialogue microbatch
Reference grouping for both deterministic literal-register arrays
direct: Pinned metadata/hash/JSON utilities and grouping constants
replace: Old batch32 actor geometry and old original-initialization requirements

review_result: Agrees with all seven prospective conditions. Boolean type derivation and supported-nonfinite failure wording clarified by protocol author before this note.
scope: Independent implementation design only; no new task scores, prediction reads, model calls or tests.
technical_prerequisite: Exact four arms by three seeds complete, all rows and finite supported predictions valid, every public recurrent update monitored. Separate from seven scientific checks.
